before.name: cusi_case_property
before.comment: A table which describes properties for a row in the cusi_case table (which holds suggested investigations). A cusi_case row can be described by multiple unique properties. Used by the the Suggested Investigations feature of the CheckUser extension.

columns.name: sicp_sic_id
columns.comment: Part of composite primary key. The cusi_case row (suggested investigation) that this property is associated with.

columns.name: sicp_property
columns.comment: Part of composite primary key. The id of the property as defined in PHP.

columns.name: sicp_value
columns.comment: The value of the property. Float is used to support decimal values.

columns.name: sicp_stale
columns.comment: Whether or not the property should be recalculated.
